text:
*[Bug 19035] postscript(): PS_Open() is too pessimistic wrt R_popen(), failing in Docker on GitHub Actions*
<https://bugs.r-project.org/show_bug.cgi?id=19035>

--- Comment #3 from Ivan Krylov (<mailto:ikrylov@disroot.org|ikrylov@disroot.org>) ---
Docker [blocks the `clone3`
syscall](<https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/42681#issuecomment-916325271>) in
unprivileged mode because their system call filter is unable to check its
arguments like it does for the ordinary `clone`.

To reproduce the problem locally, without using artificially breaking `clone3`,
run R in an unprivileged Docker container with glibc >= v2.34 inside:

```
user@debian:~$ docker run --rm -it debian:stable
root@6488c0cbcf8e:/# /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6 --version
GNU C Library (Debian GLIBC 2.41-12+deb13u3) stable release version 2.41.
...
root@6488c0cbcf8e:/# R
...
> postscript("| cat > /dev/null")
Error in postscript("| cat > /dev/null") : 
  cannot open 'postscript' pipe to ' cat > /dev/null'
> bitmap("foo.bmp")
Error in postscript(file = cmd, width = width, height = height, pointsize =
pointsize,  :
  cannot open 'postscript' pipe to ''/usr/bin/gs' -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -q
-sDEVICE=png16m -r72 -dAutoRotatePages=/None -g504x504 -sOutputFile='foo.bmp'
-'
> q()
root@6488c0cbcf8e:/# exit
user@debian:~$ /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6 --version
GNU C Library (Debian GLIBC 2.41-12+deb13u3) stable release version 2.41.
...
user@debian:~$ R
...
> postscript("| cat > /dev/null")
> plot(1:10)
> dev.off()
null device
          1
> bitmap("foo.bmp")
> plot(1:10)
> dev.off()
null device
          1
```

Podman won't reproduce the problem.

Upstream bug report [33877, successful popen set errno to ENOSYS if clone3 is
unavailable][1] doesn't always load due to the server being under attack, but
its history is visible [on the mailing
list](<https://sourceware.org/pipermail/glibc-bugs/2026-February/060830.html>).
It was [closed as
invalid](<https://sourceware.org/pipermail/glibc-bugs/2026-February/060881.html>).

[1]: <https://sourceware.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=33877>
